stem: A Quviviq prescription still shows two refills but was issued six months and two days ago. What should control the decision?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
The six-month issue-date limit prevents another Schedule IV refill.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: A Schedule III or IV prescription may not be filled or refilled more than six months after issue and may not be refilled more than five times unless renewed by the practitioner. daridorexant (Quviviq) is used for treatment of insomnia with sleep-onset or sleep-maintenance difficulty. It is federal Schedule IV and Massachusetts Schedule IV; its legal consequence in this scenario follows the cited schedule-specific rule.
